value.name: local_whisper
value.label: On-premise transcriber
value.notes: Speech recognition on a machine the institution owns (faster-whisper / WhisperX / whisper.cpp). The audio is sent to it as bytes over the LAN and never published.

value.name: onnx-community/whisper-large-v3-ONNX
value.label: large
value.notes: Highest accuracy across languages. Slow; needs a GPU.

value.name: onnx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo
value.label: large_turbo
value.notes: Nearly large-v3 accuracy, markedly less prone to repetition loops.

value.name: onnx-community/whisper-medium-ONNX
value.label: medium
value.notes: Middle ground when large will not fit.

value.name: Xenova/whisper-small
value.label: small
value.notes: Runs on CPU (32-bit weights). The fallback for machines without a GPU — a large download for its accuracy.

value.name: onnx-community/whisper-base-ONNX
value.label: base
value.notes: Runs on CPU. Fastest, least accurate. Draft use only.

value.name: onnx-community/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-ONNX
value.label: parakeet_v3
value.notes: Transducer model: cannot enter a repetition loop by construction. 25 European languages including Spanish and Catalan.

value.name: onnx-community/pyannote-segmentation-3.0
value.label: Speaker detection (pyannote segmentation 3.0)
value.notes: Detects WHO speaks WHEN (up to 3 voices), so the transcription can carry person tags at each speaker turn. Runs entirely in the browser; the identity mapping (which detected voice is which person) is always confirmed by the archivist.

value.name: onnx-community/wespeaker-voxceleb-resnet34-LM
value.label: Voice matching (WeSpeaker ResNet34-LM)
value.notes: Voice fingerprints that keep the SAME speaker tag for the same voice across a whole recording. Without it, long recordings may split one voice into several detected speakers.
